lemma retrieve (T : modes V) (x : X) :
    (∏ i∈T.val,P i x) = F.part T +
      ∑ s ∈ (T.val.powerset.erase T.val), F.part (scene s) * (cylinder D P x).part (scene (T.val\s)) := by
